info.title: FleetIQ HTTP UI baseline
info.description: Backend-owned, versioned subset of the /api/v1 HTTP surface for asset identity and semantic metadata reads. Other implemented routes are intentionally not yet described here. Protected routes are mounted only when bearer identity is configured; the current single-principal workload credential is not a browser login mechanism.

get.summary: Discover the active API major version

200.description: The active product API major version.

get.summary: List one authorized tenant's assets in stable ID order
get.description: The configured bearer identity must have a current metadata.read grant for the selected tenant. The route is absent without complete bearer configuration. A cursor traversal is not a cross-request snapshot.

parameters.name: tenant_id
parameters.description: The tenant selected for the current authorization check.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum asset summaries returned.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Exclusive asset-ID cursor from a previous page.

200.description: Bounded asset summaries. An empty catalogue returns an empty array and a null cursor.

Cache-Control.description: Protected responses are not stored by shared or browser caches.

get.description: Returns asset identity, its exact pinned asset-type version, and tenant-owned typed external identifiers. A missing asset returns 404.

parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.name: asset_id
parameters.description: Exact internal asset ID.

Cache-Control.description: Protected responses are not stored by shared or browser caches.

get.summary: Read a bounded relationship snapshot involving one asset
get.description: The latest revision known at known_at_ms is selected, then tested at effective_at_ms. Results are bounded pages ordered by stable ID. A cursor traversal is not a cross-request database snapshot; repeat the same times and limit on the next page. Both directed source and target roles are returned. The asset must exist in the current catalogue; only edges are bitemporal.

parameters.name: tenant_id
parameters.description: Tenant selected for the current metadata.read authorization check.

parameters.name: asset_id
parameters.description: Asset whose incoming and outgoing edges are queried.

schema.description: Asset whose incoming and outgoing edges are queried.

parameters.name: effective_at_ms
parameters.description: Signed Unix milliseconds when the physical relationship or binding must apply. Intervals are half-open.

schema.description: Signed Unix milliseconds when the physical relationship or binding must apply. Intervals are half-open.

parameters.name: known_at_ms
parameters.description: Signed Unix milliseconds through which recorded revisions are known; a correction may change a later snapshot.

schema.description: Signed Unix milliseconds through which recorded revisions are known; a correction may change a later snapshot.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum records returned on one page; defaults to 50.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Exclusive stable relationship ID cursor from next_after; repeat the same times and limit.

200.description: Read a bounded relationship snapshot involving one asset

Cache-Control.description: Protected responses are not stored by shared or browser caches.

get.summary: Read a bounded signal-binding snapshot for one source signal
get.description: The latest revision known at known_at_ms is selected, then tested at effective_at_ms. Results are bounded pages ordered by stable ID. A cursor traversal is not a cross-request database snapshot; repeat the same times and limit on the next page. The exact device asset, endpoint, and signal tuple selects a source; an unregistered signal can validly return an empty page.

parameters.name: signal_id
parameters.description: Decoded source signal ID.

parameters.description: Signed Unix milliseconds when the physical relationship or binding must apply. Intervals are half-open.

bearerAuth.description: Current configured workload credential. A browser-safe identity flow is not available yet.

value.description: External identifier value; no kind is assumed universal.

end_ms.description: Exclusive physical effective end; null means open-ended.

revision.description: Positive u64 revision serialized as decimal text to preserve JavaScript precision.

recorded_at_ms.description: When FleetIQ learned this revision, in signed Unix milliseconds.

effective_at_ms.description: Physical time used for this page.

known_at_ms.description: Recorded-time cutoff used for this page.

next_after.description: Exclusive stable relationship-ID cursor; null ends traversal.

RelationshipSnapshot.description: One bounded, bitemporal relationship page for an asset.

SignalSource.description: Exact device endpoint and source signal tuple.

SignalTarget.description: Semantically attributed target asset and exact property version.

revision.description: Positive u64 revision serialized as decimal text to preserve JavaScript precision.

recorded_at_ms.description: When FleetIQ learned this revision, in signed Unix milliseconds.

InvalidRequest.description: Invalid path identifier, definition version, time, limit, cursor, or query.

NotFound.description: The authorized exact resource or required current asset is absent.
